def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        bg = 5
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg
                 for c in range(width)]
                for r in range(min(len(a), len(b)))]

    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        bg = 6 if sum(v == 6 for row in a for v in row) > sum(v == 4 for row in a for v in row) else 8
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(width)]
                for r in range(h)]

    return grid

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A uniform row separates two panels; their shared background color is
    # preserved, while matching cells are marked with 3.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            n = min(len(a), len(b))
            shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
            bg = next(iter(shared)) if shared else 0
            return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else bg
                     for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]

    # Analogous case for a uniform separating column.
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            b = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
            shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
            bg = next(iter(shared)) if shared else 0
            return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else bg
                     for j in range(width)] for i in range(h)]

    return grid

    candidates = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if candidates:
        r = min(candidates, key=lambda x: abs(x - (h - 1) / 2))
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        common = set(v for row in top for v in row) & set(v for row in bottom for v in row)
        bg = max(common, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for part in (top, bottom) for row in part for x in row)) if common else grid[r][0]
        return [[3 if top[i][j] == bottom[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)]
                for i in range(n)]

    candidates = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if candidates:
        c = candidates[0]
        left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
        bg = max(common, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for part in (left, right) for row in part for x in row)) if common else grid[0][c]
        return [[3 if left[i][j] == right[i][j] else bg for j in range(width)]
                for i in range(h)]
